hooks.prompt: If the file path targets any .db file (e.g., vanguard.db, *.db), REJECT with: 'Database files must be modified through API routes or migrations, not directly edited.' Otherwise, ALLOW.

hooks.command: echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | while IFS= read -r f; do case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) npx eslint --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null;; esac; done; true

echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | while IFS= read -r f; do case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) grep -n "security_type = '" "$f" | grep -v 'LOWER(' | grep -v '^\/\/' | grep -v 'test' && echo "ERROR in $f: Use LOWER(security_type) for case-insensitive SQL comparisons" && exit 1; grep -n 'security_type ===' "$f" | grep -v 'toLowerCase' | grep -v '^\/\/' | grep -v 'test' && echo "ERROR in $f: Use .toLowerCase() for case-insensitive security_type comparisons" && exit 1;; esac; done; true
